'''Formation Besh''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] formation used by the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==History==
[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Xamuel Lennox|Lennox]] used this formation to attack [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Star Cruiser/Legends|Star Cruisers]] with his group of [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyers]] during the [[Battle of Turkana/Legends|Battle of Turkana]].
